baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Normally evasive quarry is placed within both direct bodily reach and extended instrumental reach. The test therefore occurs where real capability meets a limit: restraint becomes observable only because capture is genuinely easy enough to perform.

activation_trace.role: The image of testing that reveals a condition supplies the verse's diagnostic function.
The pursuit and taking of something resistant supplies an object whose normal elusiveness is being reduced.
Attainment and striking the object make practical access, rather than abstract desire, the pressure point.
The bodily hand supplies immediate, unmediated capture.
The spear as a thrusting implement extends agency beyond the body's immediate radius.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely warns against hunting with whatever tools happen to be available.
changed_reading.after: It stages a proximity test by bringing resistant quarry inside both direct and technologically extended reach, making available power itself the site where restraint is disclosed.

baseline_models.mechanism: The trial converts an inward orientation unavailable to sight into a visible decision. Security of commitment and expectation of an unseen consequence coexist: what the person trusts and fears is registered by what an able hand declines to take.

activation_trace.role: Heart-security and trust supply the stable inward commitment against which fear is not mere panic.
An ordeal that makes the true state appear supplies the passage from inward posture to readable conduct.
A distinguishing mark supplies the test's outward identifier of the otherwise hidden person.
Dread that anticipates harm supplies prospective restraint before any consequence is seen.
Concealment from eyes locates the decisive relation beyond ordinary surveillance.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks whether people feel fear when no observer is visible.
changed_reading.after: The reachable quarry is an instrument for externalizing a concealed orientation: trust and anticipated unseen consequence become legible in a voluntary non-act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction joins a crossed boundary to a temporal 'after that.' Liability is sharpened not by proximity alone but by proceeding across an already presented limit, after the testing situation has made the choice intelligible.

activation_trace.role: Passing a limit and wronging supplies the decisive movement beyond permission.
After opposed to before supplies a sequence in which notice precedes culpable crossing.
Punitive pain supplies the consequence assigned to the knowing breach.
The description as pain-causing intensifies consequence beyond a neutral legal adjustment.

changed_reading.before: Any contact with game is followed by punishment.
changed_reading.after: The warning targets a knowingly crossed boundary after disclosure; the moral sequence is access, notice, transgression, then painful consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding rules preserve lawful appetite while changing its boundary by state, terrain, duration, and intent. Self-imposed blanket prohibition is rejected; deliberate killing of game while consecrated is penalized; sea game remains available while land game is suspended. The quarry's reachability is therefore maintained affordance inside a situational restraint, not evidence that hunting or food is intrinsically rejected.

activation_trace.role: Actual attainment supplies the live affordance whose legal status must be distinguished from physical availability.
Prohibition as prevention supplies the act believers are told not to manufacture for themselves.
Release of a restriction supplies the lawful field that remains real around the test.
Consecration supplies the temporary state in which the otherwise available quarry becomes protected.
Deliberate purpose supplies the culpable direction from capacity toward killing.
The lifting of restriction for sea game prevents the test from becoming a total ban on taking food.
Wide abundant water supplies the permitted ecological domain beside the restricted one.
Prohibition joined to consecration supplies both the restraint and its bounded duration.
Dry land supplies the contrasting ecological domain where game remains physically present but legally withheld.

structural_cues: 5:87 couples refusal of self-made prohibition with refusal of transgression.
5:95 follows the test by naming killing, consecration, deliberate intent, equivalence, and compensatory consequence.
5:96 contrasts permitted sea game with land game forbidden only while consecration lasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lawful appetite, consecrated status, deliberate killing, and a sea/land asymmetry; I infer that preserved opportunity is part of the testing mechanism because restraint must operate amid alternatives. A live alternative is that these verses only delimit law and do not explain why the prey is made reachable.

changed_reading.before: Reachable game is a generic temptation and the safest response is broad abstinence from hunting.
changed_reading.after: Reachable game tests precise boundary-keeping: lawful appetite and real access remain, while intent, consecrated state, ecological domain, and duration determine when taking becomes transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later clauses place God's comprehensive knowledge beside the opposition between what people expose and conceal, and again name Him knower of hidden things. This shifts 'so that God may know' toward manifestation and identification: the trial gives hidden allegiance a distinguishing historical mark rather than supplying previously absent divine information.

activation_trace.role: A mark that distinguishes supplies the focus clause with a manifesting rather than information-acquiring function.
What is screened from eyes supplies the inward state to be rendered legible.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supports the stated encompassing knowledge surrounding the test.
Emergence into view supplies the outward pole of conduct.
Hiding and covering supply the inward pole that remains known despite concealment.
The contrast between creatures' denied knowledge and divine knowing sharpens the direction of disclosure.
Hidden things screened from observers confirm that unseen status is no barrier to divine knowledge.

structural_cues: 5:97 states that God knows what is in the heavens and earth and knows every thing.
5:99 directly coordinates divine knowing with what people disclose and conceal.
5:109 contrasts the messengers' lack of knowledge with God's knowledge of hidden things.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive knowledge, disclosure/concealment, and repeated knowledge of hidden things; I infer that the trial's directional arrow is hidden orientation becoming marked conduct. A live alternative is to leave 'may know' as experiential recognition without specifying whether the manifestation is for the agent, the community, judgment, or all three.

changed_reading.before: The test obtains information that God did not yet possess.
changed_reading.after: The test manifests and marks within conduct who maintains unseen-directed restraint, making a hidden allegiance historically identifiable inside already encompassing knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposition of bad and good is held firm even when the bad is abundant and pleasing to the eye. Applied back to reachable quarry, ease, quantity, and attraction are not signs of value or permission; they are precisely the sensory conditions under which qualitative judgment must resist affordance.

activation_trace.role: The image of the self being drawn toward a thing supplies attraction within the indefinite sample of quarry.
Easy attainment supplies availability, which the context prevents from functioning as a value judgment.
Inferior badness opposed to goodness supplies the qualitative distinction that quantity cannot erase.
Goodness contrary to badness supplies the alternative value pole.
Something appearing beautiful to the eye supplies the lure by which quantity recruits desire.
Numerical abundance supplies the misleading signal that the qualitative boundary must overrule.

structural_cues: 5:100 denies equivalence between bad and good despite an explicit concessive appeal to abundant badness.
The maxim follows the hunt rules and repeats the call to protective awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies qualitative opposition, visual appeal, and abundance; I infer that reachable quarry is one concrete affordance through which those signals can be mistaken for permission. A live alternative is that 5:100 generalizes beyond hunting without specifically interpreting the mechanism of 5:94.

changed_reading.before: The prey is tempting simply because an individual animal happens to be nearby.
changed_reading.after: The test exposes a broader inferential error: what is plentiful, attractive, and attainable can still fall on the wrong side of a qualitative boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against forcing disclosure about unspecified things is followed by rejection of fabricated sacred-animal categories. Read back into 'something of the hunt,' the indefinite test remains bounded by the limits actually disclosed; it does not authorize anxious expansion of a situational game rule into a proliferating animal taxonomy.

activation_trace.role: The general knowable 'thing' supplies the focus verse's deliberately indefinite sample.
Questioning as request supplies the pressure to force further specification.
The repeated general category of things links indeterminacy to the warning about needless disclosure.
Coming into view supplies the potentially burdensome disclosure that questioning would produce.
Making or instituting supplies the divine act explicitly denied for the invented classes.
The released sacred animal left without ordinary use supplies one concrete fabricated category.
The pre-Islamic sheep category supplies a second animal classification not grounded in divine institution.
The protected breeding camel supplies another case of manufactured immunity from use.
Inventing a lie supplies the mechanism by which self-made categories are falsely attached to God.

structural_cues: 5:101 warns that requested disclosure can itself create distress.
5:103 denies that God instituted four named animal classes and attributes them to fabrication.
The earlier 5:87 already forbids believers from making lawful good things forbidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies indefinite 'things,' pressured disclosure, and explicit rejection of fabricated animal restrictions; I infer a guardrail from the focus's bounded sample to limits on legal proliferation. A live alternative is that 5:101-103 addresses separate abuses and only indirectly constrains how 5:94 should be extended.

changed_reading.before: The indefinite 'something of game' encourages maximal precaution and further sacred-animal restrictions.
changed_reading.after: The trial is bounded by disclosed limits: its indeterminacy tests obedience without licensing invented categories or converting caution into self-authored prohibition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witness procedure makes concealed conduct answerable through testimony, doubt, replacement witnesses, and the prospect that oaths will be returned. Its explicit claim that witnesses may fear reversal gives a social-legal analogue for fearing in the unseen: conduct is restrained now by an anticipated review not presently visible.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of an adverse consequence supplies inward deterrence before review occurs.
What is hidden from present sight supplies the absent-review condition.
Testimony as statement grounded in knowledge supplies a channel by which concealed events become accountable.
Disturbing doubt activates procedural scrutiny rather than leaving hidden conduct sealed.
Concealment supplies the specific failure that testimony and oath are designed to resist.
Competing declarations based on claimed knowledge supply the review that can displace an initial account.
The repeated language of crossing a limit links procedural dishonesty back to the focus transgression.
Truthful testimony supplies the behavior the review architecture seeks to elicit.
Explicit fear of a later adverse event supplies the procedural counterpart to unseen-directed restraint.
Return to its source supplies the threatened reversal of the first oath.
The binding oath supplies the speech act exposed to later contradiction.

structural_cues: 5:106 establishes testimony under oath in a setting where facts and motives can be concealed.
5:107 provides replacement witnesses when wrongdoing is discovered.
5:108 explicitly says the procedure is likelier to produce proper testimony or fear that later oaths will overturn earlier ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed testimony, doubt, replacement, returned oaths, and explicit fear; I infer that anticipated review is a concrete social mechanism analogous to fear directed through the unseen. A live alternative is that the witness procedure illustrates deterrence generally without defining the devotional object of fear in 5:94.

changed_reading.before: Fearing God in the unseen is an unstructured private feeling.
changed_reading.after: It functions as an internalized audit: an agent restrains a presently possible act because hidden conduct remains exposed to later review, reversal, and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table episode turns distant trust into tangible food meant to reassure hearts and verify truth, then makes denial after its descent carry exceptional punishment. In parallel, quarry made attainable can be a provision-sign whose nearness increases responsibility: access is not merely temptation but favor under evidence, so breach 'after that' becomes aggravated ingratitude.

activation_trace.role: Attainment supplies the focus verse's tangible nearness.
The hand as received favor opens the possibility that access is also gift rather than only temptation.
Delivery downward supplies the requested movement of provision into human access.
A food-bearing table supplies the tangible object that joins nourishment to sign.
Settled reassurance supplies the inward change expected from tangible provision.
The heart supplies the inward location where material access is meant to stabilize trust.
Knowledge through disclosure supplies the requested evidentiary effect of the table.
Fulfillment in act supplies verification that the promise was true.
An apportioned gift supplies the table's character as received provision.
Actual delivery supplies the transition from requested possibility to present evidence.
Covering a benefit supplies post-provision ingratitude rather than ignorance before evidence.
After opposed to before repeats the focus sequence in which disclosure precedes aggravated breach.
Punitive pain supplies the heightened consequence attached to denial after tangible provision.

structural_cues: 5:112 requests that food descend within reach while coupling the request to protective awareness and belief.
5:113 gives eating, heart-reassurance, knowledge, and witnessing as simultaneous purposes.
5:115 places exceptional punishment specifically after the promised provision has descended.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered food, reassurance, verified truth, provision, and punishment after denial; I infer that made-near quarry can likewise be favor-as-test, with access increasing evidentiary responsibility. A live alternative is that the table's exceptional sign status makes the parallel rhetorical rather than legally transferable.

changed_reading.before: The nearness of prey is only an external temptation made harder to resist.
changed_reading.after: Made-near provision can be both gift and proof: tangibility should settle fidelity, and therefore a breach after access is granted carries the weight of rejected favor under evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing declaration assigns dominion over all realms and capacity over every thing to God. Human hands and spears therefore express real but derivative reach: ability to seize an animal does not establish ownership of permission, because both object and capacity remain nested in a larger sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Successful attainment supplies the human capacity that might be mistaken for entitlement.
The possessing hand supplies the local claim of control that the closing dominion relativizes.
Sovereign dominion supplies the encompassing ownership within which human taking occurs.
The unrestricted category of every knowable thing includes both quarry and human instruments within the closure.
Effective power that reaches action and possession supplies the ultimate capacity over human capacities.

structural_cues: 5:120 closes the pericope by assigning the dominion of heavens, earth, and all they contain to God.
The same closing clause places divine capacity over every thing, echoing the focus's indefinite 'something.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal dominion and effective capacity; I infer a hierarchy in which physical reach is delegated power rather than self-validating title. A live alternative is that the closing doxology establishes general sovereignty without specifically recoding the hands and spears.

changed_reading.before: Whatever falls within a person's effective hand or weapon is presumptively theirs to take.
changed_reading.after: Reach proves capacity, not entitlement: the hand's local control and the spear's extension remain subordinate to the dominion that sets the boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses the ordinary hunter-object relation and treats the quarry functionally as a probe of the hunter. It remains anchored in the explicit test, the quarry's resistance, and its engineered attainability; downstream prose should present it as a causal model of the scene, not claim that 'quarry' lexically means testing instrument.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals condition supplies the diagnostic purpose assigned to the encounter.
A normally resistant target supplies the apparent object whose altered behavior exposes the pursuer.
Attainability supplies the controlled change that lets the quarry register the human response.

changed_reading.before: The human hunts and tests the accessibility of prey.
changed_reading.after: Functionally, the made-accessible prey tests the human: the apparent object of pursuit becomes the probe that reveals the pursuer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the restraint sense of ع ذ ب beneath the explicit punitive-pain sense and links it to fasting in 5:95. It remains anchored in the focus punishment and the immediate compensatory sequence; downstream prose should mark it as a structural analogy, not replace the ordinary meaning of punishment.

activation_trace.role: Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply the exploratory image of restraint returning coercively.
Pain supplies the explicit containment that prevents the model from dissolving punishment into mere discipline.
Fasting as abstention supplies an actual imposed restraint among the consequences of deliberate killing.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing supplies the offender's embodied encounter with consequence.
Injurious heaviness supplies the burdensome quality of the returned restraint.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an unrelated pain added after failed restraint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refused voluntary abstention returns as imposed abstention and experienced heaviness: consequence reproduces coercively the restraint the agent would not supply freely.

strongest_changes: The immediate legal context revised a generic hunting warning into a situational affordance test: lawful appetite remains, while consecration, terrain, duration, and deliberate intent locate the boundary.
Repeated knowledge, disclosure, concealment, and hidden-things language shifted 'so that God may know' from acquiring missing information to manifesting and marking concealed allegiance in conduct.
The witness and table episodes recast unseen fear as reviewable conscience and tangible provision as intensified responsibility after evidence.
summary.what_was_special: Across the four-pericope packet, tangible access repeatedly becomes a disclosure device: prey reaches hand and spear, testimony can be overturned, food descends to reassure hearts, and breach after disclosure carries sharper consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: Hands and spears may name only two literal hunting ranges, or may deliberately span bodily and technologically extended agency.
The anti-taboo reading from 5:101-103 may directly constrain extension of 5:94, or may function only as a broader guardrail against synthesis.
The manifestation reading of لِيَعْلَمَ is strongly supported by the packet's knowledge pattern but still includes a reader-supplied account of the clause's theological direction.
